name: Aurora
description: Aurora is a read-only connector that puts your Consilio engagement, document, and other data at Claude's fingertips. Ask Claude to find a matter by client or alpha-code, list the workspaces inside it, run a full-text search across documents. AI-powered investigations let Claude follow an answer across matters, workspaces, and documents in a single conversation — automatically narrowing ambiguous queries to the right context and citing a direct source URL on every record. Every response is scoped to what you're already entitled to see on the Consilio web products.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Aurora to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Aurora to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.ai.consilio.com/. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Aurora MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Aurora provides these MCP tools: searchMatters, searchWorkspaces, searchDocuments, and searchTickets.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Aurora?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Aurora in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
Aurora requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Aurora is developed by Consilio, LLC. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
